title: dLocal Limited 2025 Form 20-F
excerpt: For 2025, dLocal's top 10 merchants represented 61% of total revenue.
summary: The audited 2025 annual filing confirms dLocal Limited's Nasdaq Class A listing, payment-infrastructure model, 61% revenue concentration among its ten largest merchants, emerging-market regulatory and foreign-exchange exposures, working-capital and safeguarded-funds constraints, pending securities litigation, and the March 2026 authorization of a USD 300 million share-repurchase program.
